title: pre-tool hook lets a tool call through when the gate raises
detail: An uncaught exception in pre_tool exits rc 1, which Claude Code treats as a non-blocking hook error, so the tool runs ungated. Repro: a Bash command holding about 2000 repeats of '"$( ' raises RecursionError from _double_quote_end/_substitution_end and rc is 1. Any other fault in the policy path behaves the same. The check must deny through the adapter when it cannot finish.
